title: Where the data actually goes — now answerable
description: source → processor → destination · one thread per data path · hover to trace a route · hover any label to pull its whole bundle · click to pin, click empty space to release

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered source/processor/destination indices and nonnegative volume in thousands of events per day. Missing volume or an invalid endpoint makes the route unavailable. Zero-volume routes have no thread.

props.name: sources
props.description: Ordered source labels; indices preserve repeated names as separate nodes.

props.name: processors
props.description: Ordered processor labels, revealed on inspection.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
